originalTitle: Saudi Arabia’s new Exobot EVs make the Cybertruck look normal

content: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is mostly known for its global dominance over petroleum production and oil reserves — not necessarily cars and auto manufacturing, and certainly not electric vehicle production. So it was a little surprising on Monday when a Saudi startup called Ceer unveiled a pair of hyper-angular, spaceship-like EVs, with plans to launch an additional five models by 2030. The Exobot (yes, that’s the real name) sedan and SUV are expected to go on sale in Saudi Arabia starting in 2027. The ultra-futuristic designs scream Tron, Blade Runner, and every other sci-fi movie you’ve seen — and then some. The gullwing doors are ripped straight from the Tesla Model X (which, of course, was ripped straight from the DeLorean and a range of other rare production cars). Wild and wedge-shaped, the Exobots seemed built explicitly to draw attention. Which, in an attention-based economy, is probably the right strategy. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/CEER-WALL-CHARGER-WITH-SIGNATURE-PEDESTAL.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-EXTERIOR-FRONT-TOP-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-EXTERIOR-SIDE-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-ULTRAFAST-CHARGING.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SUV-DOORS-OPEN.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SUV-FRONT-QTR-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SHOWCAR-SEDAN-DOORS-FR3Q.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SHOWCAR-SEDAN-FRONT.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SHOWCAR-SEDAN-HIGH-SIDE.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SHOWCAR-SUV-DOORS-FR3Q.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] The sedan Exobot has low-slung, supercar proportions with a steeply raked windshield that flows seamlessly into the hood. The front fascia features a razor-thin, full-width LED light bar nestled under a sharp, forward-jutting nose, giving it a mean, visor-like glare. The two-tone bodywork and ample windshield immediately had me thinking about the Ferrari Luce, the polarizing electric supercar released earlier this year. The SUV boasts a blocky, military-meets-cyberpunk stance with high ground clearance and aggressive angles. The whole thing looks thick and armor-plated, with a flat roofline and a distinctive, tactical presence. I wouldn’t be surprised to see this thing bouncing along the Moon’s surface someday. Both were designed by Rob Melville, McLaren’s former design director. But according to Autocar, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman had final say on the design.  [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-INTELLIGENT-COCKPIT.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-2ND-ROW-SEATS.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-INTERIOR-BLACK-WITH-GREEN-ACCENTS.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-INTERIOR-DIGITAL-HORIZON-DISPLAY.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-INTERIOR-FIRST-EDITION.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-INTERIOR-YOKE-STEERING.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/HMI-CHARGING-MODE.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/HMI-FIRST-EDITION-DIGITAL-HORIZON-DISPLAY.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Ceer is hoping to take advantage of all the upheaval in the global car market, driven largely by the flood of Chinese electric vehicle exports in Asia, Europe, and South America. The US appears on its way to becoming an automotive backwater, with its ahistorical embrace of internal combustion engines and steep tariffs designed to keep Chinese EVs at bay. Why not release a pair of bombastic Batmobiles as a way to distract from the originating country’s extreme oil dependency? Ceer didn’t exactly emerge from nothing. Rather, it’s a joint venture between Saudi Arabia’s PIF sovereign wealth fund and Foxconn, the Taiwanese company most known for manufacturing the iPhone for Apple. The company will be funded by the kingdom’s vast oil wealth, but with the purpose of building a lineup of vehicles that run on electricity. Even though it’s distinctly a project built to jump-start the kingdom’s auto industry, Ceer needed to venture outside its borders when hiring for its top roles. Jim DeLuca spent 37 at General Motors, ending up as executive VP for global manufacturing, before joining Ceer as CEO. “We ⁠wanted to make sure the world could see what Saudi Arabia is capable of,” DeLuca told Reuters. The kingdom has had mixed luck when it comes to automotive projects. There were plans to build a Jaguar-Land Rover factory there over a decade ago, but to no avail. Toyota declined a deal with the Saudis in 2019. The Public Investment Fund owns a controlling stake in California-based Lucid Motors, which is now building a manufacturing facility in King Abdullah Economic City. Ceer is taking a diversified approach to its vehicle lineup. While the first models will be electric, subsequent vehicles will be hybrid and combustion-engine, depending on market demands. chineseContent: 沙特阿拉伯王国以其在石油生产和石油储量方面的全球主导地位而闻名——不一定是汽车和汽车制造，当然也不是电动汽车生产。因此，周一，一家名为 Ceer 的沙特初创公司推出了两款超棱角、类似宇宙飞船的电动汽车，并计划在 2030 年之前推出另外 5 款车型，这有点令人惊讶。Exobot（是的，这就是真名）轿车和 SUV 预计将于 2027 年开始在沙特阿拉伯上市。超未来主义的设计让《创》、《银翼杀手》和你看过的所有其他科幻电影都惊叹不已。鸥翼门直接从 Tesla Model X 上抄下来（当然，它是直接从 DeLorean 和一系列其他稀有量产车上抄下来的）。 Exobots 狂野且呈楔形，似乎是为了吸引注意力而专门设计的。在以注意力为基础的经济中，这可能是正确的策略。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/CEER-WALL-CHARGER-WITH-SIGNATURE-PEDESTAL.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-EXTERIOR-FRONT-TOP-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-EXTERIOR-SIDE-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SEDAN-ULTRAFAST-CHARGING.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SUV-DOORS-OPEN.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片： https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/EXOBOT-SUV-FRONT-QTR-VIEW.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/SHOWCAR-SEDAN-
